title: LoongServe: Efficiently Serving Long-Context Large Language Models with Elastic Sequence Parallelism
technique: Elastic sequence parallelism: per-iteration adjustment of degree of parallelism across elastic instances, KV migration/scale-up/scale-down without copying, and a 4-step global scheduler (request selection, instance allocation, batching DP, KV placement)

optimized_metrics.evidence: We focus on the serving throughput. ... To compare different systems, we set a latency service level objective (SLO) and compare the maximum throughput under this SLO.
we set a latency service level objective (SLO) and compare the maximum throughput under this SLO. Similar to prior work [28, 32, 54], we set SLO to 25x of the inference latency.
The optimization goal is to minimize the input latency of R_p on E_p.
optimized_metrics.stat_quote: normalized input latency, i.e., the mean of prefill phase time divided by the input lengths (§7.1 Metrics)

optimized_metrics.evidence: The performance cost, i.e., the impact of preemption on the output token latency, is formulated as follows: Cost = sum T(R_p U R'_p,i, E_p U G_p,i) / r.output_len
optimized_metrics.stat_quote: normalized output latency, i.e., the mean of decoding phase time divided by the output lengths (§7.1 Metrics)

optimized_metrics.evidence: The GPU memory of LoongServe elastic instances also forms a unified distributed key-value cache pool, which can be flexibly used to store key-value tensors of requests at the granularity of a token across elastic instances to reduce GPU memory fragmentation (§4).

headline_claim.text: LoongServe improves the throughput by up to 3.85x compared to chunked prefill and 5.81x compared to prefill-decoding disaggregation.

metric_definitions.definition_quote: we measure the normalized per-token latency, i.e., the mean of requests' end-to-end latency divided by their sequence lengths
metric_definitions.notes: Divided by total sequence length (input+output), not output length as in vLLM/Orca.

metric_definitions.definition_quote: normalized input latency, i.e., the mean of prefill phase time divided by the input lengths
metric_definitions.notes: Prefill-phase time per input token; a TTFT proxy normalized by prompt length.

metric_definitions.definition_quote: the normalized output latency, i.e., the mean of decoding phase time divided by the output lengths
metric_definitions.notes: Decode-phase time per output token (TPOT-like, but includes any decode queueing/preemption).

metric_definitions.definition_quote: P90 goodput (throughput of requests under the SLO) [61]
metric_definitions.notes: Following DistServe; request-rate at which 90% attainment is met.

metric_definitions.definition_quote: we set a latency service level objective (SLO) and compare the maximum throughput under this SLO. Similar to prior work [28, 32, 54], we set SLO to 25x of the inference latency.
metric_definitions.notes: 'inference latency' undefined here (presumably single-request unloaded latency); SLO is a multiple (25x), applied to normalized latency.

metric_definitions.definition_quote: LoongServe improves the total throughput and input throughput by up to 3.85x and 3.37x.
metric_definitions.notes: Total = input+output tokens presumably; input throughput = prompt tokens/s; neither defined formally.

slo_spec: SLO set to 25x the inference latency (following vLLM-style prior work); compare maximum throughput under the SLO; P90 goodput in ablation
load_regime: request-rate sweep on four real-world long-context datasets (ShareGPT, LEval, LV-Eval, Mixed) plus Zipf length distributions
hardware: servers with 8x NVIDIA A800 80GB, NVLink, 4x200Gbps InfiniBand (up to 2 nodes)
workloads: ShareGPT, LEval, LV-Eval, Mixed; sequence lengths up to ~500K tokens
extractor_notes: Headline 'throughput' is max request-rate-derived throughput at SLO (25x), i.e. SLO-conditioned, effectively goodput-like but not named so in the headline. Internal scheduler minimizes prefill (input) latency per token and weighs decode (output token) latency cost of preemption. Normalization divides by total sequence length unlike vLLM. 'inference latency' baseline for the 25x SLO is not defined. Model size list not fully verified.
load_class_quote: the arrival pattern of requests is generated by a Poisson process (§7.1 Workloads; request-rate sweeps)
